paite: Huai ni chiangin hichi bangin na chi dinga. TOUPA aw, kipahthu ka hon hilh hi; ka tungah na hehta mah lechin, na hehna lah a daita, nang honkhamuante neive.
english: In that day you will say, “I will give thanks to you, Yahweh; for though you were angry with me, your anger has turned away and you comfort me.

paite: Ngaiin, Pathian lah honhondampa ahi a; ka gingta dinga, lauin ka om kei ding; TOUPA Jehova lah ka hatna leh ka la ahi ngala, honhondampa leng ahi, chiin.
english: Behold, God is my salvation. I will trust, and will not be afraid; for Yah, Yahweh, is my strength and song; and he has become my salvation.”

paite: Huaijiakin hotdamna tuikhuk akipan nuamin tui na tai ding uh.
english: Therefore with joy you will draw water out of the wells of salvation.

paite: Huan, huai niin hichiin na chi ding. TOUPA kiangah kipahthu hilh unla, a min lou unla, a thilhihte mi chih lakah theisak unla, a min pahtawiin a om chih gen un.
english: In that day you will say, “Give thanks to Yahweh! Call on his name. Declare his doings among the peoples. Proclaim that his name is exalted!

paite: TOUPA pahtawiin lasa un; aman lah thil hoihpente a nahihta ngala; huai tuh lei tengtengah theihin om hen.Ziona omte aw, ngaihtakin kikou unla, kikou vengvung un, Israelte Mi Siangthou na lak ua om lah a thupi ngala, chiin.
english: Sing to Yahweh, for he has done excellent things! Let this be known in all the earth!

paite: Ziona omte aw, ngaihtakin kikou unla, kikou vengvung un, Israelte Mi Siangthou na lak ua om lah a thupi ngala, chiin.
english: Cry aloud and shout, you inhabitant of Zion; for the Holy One of Israel is great in the midst of you!”
